description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEnvironment in the OpenClaw project, focusing on parsing semantic versions, version output normalization, compatibility checks, gateway port handling, and version extraction.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test functions to validate version parsing, normalization, port configuration, and compatibility logic related to the GatewayEnvironment.

methods.name: `semver parses common forms`
methods.description: Tests the parsing of various semantic version strings, including those with prefixes, suffixes, and invalid formats.

methods.name: `gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing`
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway version output can be normalized by removing the product prefix before parsing.

methods.name: `semver compatibility requires same major and not older`
methods.description: Tests the comparison logic to determine if a semantic version is compatible with a required version, based on major and minor versions.

methods.name: `gateway port defaults and respects override`
methods.description: Checks that the default gateway port is correctly set and that UserDefaults overrides are respected.

methods.name: `expected gateway version from string uses parser`
methods.description: Validates that version strings are correctly parsed into Semver objects, including handling of nil input.
